items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 results preview: PAT may rise up to 32% YoY; margins, loan growth in focus
items.description: Kotak Mahindra Bank is likely to report significant year-on-year growth in net profit for Q2FY27. Brokerages estimate profit after tax to rise between 27% and 31.9%, driven by strong net interest income growth. Loan and deposit growth will remain key factors influencing the bank's overall performance and profitability. Investors will closely monitor net interest margins and operating expenses for signs of sustainability.

items.title: Nuvoco Vistas Corp Q2 profit jumps 78% to Rs 65 crore on strong revenue
items.description: Nuvoco Vistas Corp achieved a consolidated profit growth of 78% year-on-year to Rs 65 crore. Revenue also increased by over 13% to Rs 2,790 crore during the September quarter. The company sold 4.7 million tonnes of cement, which was up 9% from the previous year. Nuvoco expects cement demand to rise after the monsoon season with upcoming government-led capex.

items.title: HPCL reports 6% decline in profit for Q2 amidst rising fuel prices
items.description: Hindustan Petroleum Corp has reported a 6% decline in consolidated net profit for the second quarter of FY27. The company returned to profitability in Q2 FY27 after suffering a significant loss in Q1 FY27. Revenue from product sales increased by 26% compared to the previous year's second quarter. Despite the quarterly revenue growth, losses were reported for the first half of FY27 due to high crude oil prices.

items.title: JSW Steel Q2 Results: Net profit rockets 225% YoY to Rs 5,279 crore; revenue rises 21%
items.description: JSW Steel Q2 Results:  JSW Steel reported a 225% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 5,279 crore, while revenue rose 21% to Rs 54,486 crore. EBITDA climbed 39% to Rs 9,941 crore, with crude steel production and steel sales hitting record highs. However, shares fell around 3% after results.

items.title: Adani Power Q2 Results: Profit zooms 134% YoY to Rs 6,919 crore; revenue jumps 45%
items.description: Adani Power has reported an impressive consolidated net profit of Rs 6,919 crore for the second quarter of FY27, which marks a striking 134% increase from last year's profit of Rs 2,953 crore during the same period. Additionally, their operational revenue surged to Rs 19,439 crore, representing a 45% growth from Rs 13,457 crore the previous year.

items.title: Sterlite Technologies Q2 Results: Profit surges 12,817% YoY to Rs 517 crore, revenue jumps 145%
items.description: Sterlite Technologies reported a 12,817% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 517 crore, while revenue surged 145% to a record Rs 2,529 crore. Strong demand for AI-ready digital infrastructure, improved margins and a one-time tariff refund gain supported performance, as its open order book reached Rs 35,274 crore.

items.title: Bansal Wire Industries Q2 net profit jumps 38% to Rs 53 crore
items.description: Bansal Wire Industries reported a remarkable consolidated net profit of Rs 52.9 crore for the quarter ending in September, marking a substantial 38 percent growth compared to the previous year. The company's revenue surged by 23.9 percent, amounting to Rs 1,308.1 crore for the same period. Sales volume also experienced a 12.4 percent increase, reaching 1.29 LT, while both EBITDA and EBITDA per tonne achieved record highs this quarter.

items.title: SBI Cards Q2 profit jumps 75% YoY to Rs 778 crore as bad loan costs fall sharply
items.description: SBI Cards reported a 75% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 778 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by lower credit costs and improved asset quality. However, corporate card spending declined, receivables contracted, and net interest margins narrowed.

items.title: Dr Reddy’s Q2 Results: Net profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 913 crore, revenue declines marginally
items.description: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories reported a 36% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 913.4 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue slipped 1.5%. North America weakness pressured performance, offset partly by growth in India and emerging markets, alongside biosimilar approvals and strategic partnerships.

items.title: Infosys dividend alert! IT major announces Rs 26 per share dividend. Check record date
items.description: Infosys has declared an interim dividend of Rs 26 per equity share for its shareholders. The record date for this dividend is set for November 3, with payment scheduled for November 11. This announcement follows a final dividend of Rs 25 per share declared in June.

items.title: Infosys Q2 Results: Profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore; co lowers revenue guidance
items.description: Infosys Q2 Results: IT services major Infosys Ltd on Friday reported 6% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 7,823 crore in the second quarter. The same stood at Rs 7,364 crore in the year-ago period. The company has trimmed its revenue growth guidance to 1-2% in constant currency for FY27 as against 1.5-3% given earlier.

items.title: IndusInd Bank Q2 Results: Lender posts profit of Rs 1,176 crore vs Rs 445 crore loss a year ago
items.description: In the second quarter of this fiscal year, IndusInd Bank reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,176 crore, showcasing a remarkable turnaround from a loss of Rs 445 crore in the same quarter last year. The bank's net interest income increased by 4% year-on-year to Rs 4,569 crore, driven by enhanced asset quality, while gross non-performing assets decreased to 2.73% of gross advances, indicating robust profitability and growth momentum.

items.title: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: Co swings to black with  Rs 1,254 crore profit; revenue jumps 37% YoY
items.description: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results: The improvement in profitability was driven by lower mark-to-market losses on investments in Tata Capital Ltd. The company reported a strong net cash position of Rs 15,900 crore as of September 30, 2026.
